{
  "dataset_name": "pima_diabetes",
  "model_family": "distance_knn",
  "schema_generator": "claude-sonnet-4.6",
  "schema_version": "1.0",
  "features": [
    {
      "name": "zscore_euclidean_dist",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Euclidean distance of the row from the training-set centroid in z-score space, measuring how far a sample is from the average patient profile",
      "value_range": [0.0, 12.0],
      "feature_family": "prototype_distance",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures overall deviation from the population center; helps KNN identify outlier neighborhoods",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.sqrt(((preg - 3.845) / 3.367) ** 2 + ((plas - 120.895) / 31.952) ** 2 + ((pres - 69.105) / 19.343) ** 2 + ((skin - 20.536) / 15.942) ** 2 + ((insu - 79.799) / 115.169) ** 2 + ((mass - 31.993) / 7.879) ** 2 + ((pedi - 0.472) / 0.331) ** 2 + ((age - 33.241) / 11.753) ** 2)"
    },
    {
      "name": "plas_zscore",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Z-score normalized plasma glucose, the most diagnostically relevant feature for diabetes, scaled for distance computation",
      "value_range": [-3.8, 2.5],
      "feature_family": "scale_normalized",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Normalizes the most important feature for KNN distance calculations, preventing scale dominance",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(plas - 120.895) / 31.952"
    },
    {
      "name": "mass_zscore",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Z-score normalized BMI, scaled for uniform contribution to KNN distance metrics",
      "value_range": [-4.1, 4.5],
      "feature_family": "scale_normalized",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Ensures BMI contributes proportionally to distance calculations alongside other features",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(mass - 31.993) / 7.879"
    },
    {
      "name": "age_zscore",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Z-score normalized age, scaled for uniform contribution to KNN distance metrics",
      "value_range": [-1.05, 4.07],
      "feature_family": "scale_normalized",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Normalizes age for distance-based comparisons, preventing age from dominating raw-scale distances",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(age - 33.241) / 11.753"
    },
    {
      "name": "plas_mass_interaction_norm",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Product of z-score normalized plasma glucose and BMI, capturing joint metabolic risk signal in a scale-free manner",
      "value_range": [-15.0, 12.0],
      "feature_family": "scale_normalized",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Encodes joint metabolic risk in a single dimension, improving neighborhood separation for KNN",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "((plas - 120.895) / 31.952) * ((mass - 31.993) / 7.879)"
    },
    {
      "name": "log_insu_norm",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log-transformed and z-score normalized insulin level, reducing skewness for better distance geometry",
      "value_range": [-2.5, 3.5],
      "feature_family": "scale_normalized",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Reduces insulin skewness so high-insulin outliers do not distort KNN neighborhoods",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(np.log1p(insu) - 3.255) / 1.847"
    },
    {
      "name": "metabolic_composite_score",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Composite score combining z-scored plasma glucose, BMI, and insulin as a metabolic risk axis for prototype distance",
      "value_range": [-6.0, 8.0],
      "feature_family": "prototype_distance",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Creates a single metabolic axis that concentrates discriminative signal, improving KNN cluster separation",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "((plas - 120.895) / 31.952) + ((mass - 31.993) / 7.879) + ((np.log1p(insu) - 3.255) / 1.847)"
    },
    {
      "name": "age_preg_norm_dist",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Euclidean distance in the normalized age-pregnancy subspace, capturing reproductive history relative to age",
      "value_range": [0.0, 6.0],
      "feature_family": "prototype_distance",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures age-pregnancy joint deviation from population center, useful for KNN in demographic subspace",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.sqrt(((age - 33.241) / 11.753) ** 2 + ((preg - 3.845) / 3.367) ** 2)"
    },
    {
      "name": "plas_deviation_from_normal",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Absolute deviation of plasma glucose from the clinical normal fasting threshold of 100 mg/dL, normalized by training std",
      "value_range": [0.0, 3.1],
      "feature_family": "prototype_distance",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Measures distance from a clinically meaningful reference point, improving KNN boundary near glucose threshold",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.abs(plas - 100.0) / 31.952"
    },
    {
      "name": "bmi_clinical_deviation",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Absolute deviation of BMI from the clinical overweight threshold of 25 kg/m2, normalized by training std",
      "value_range": [0.0, 5.4],
      "feature_family": "prototype_distance",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Encodes distance from a clinically meaningful BMI reference, sharpening KNN boundaries near overweight threshold",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.abs(mass - 25.0) / 7.879"
    },
    {
      "name": "high_risk_metabolic_indicator",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Binary indicator for simultaneously elevated plasma glucose (above training mean) and elevated BMI (above training mean), flagging a high-risk metabolic cluster",
      "value_range": [0, 1],
      "feature_family": "cluster_indicator",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a hard cluster membership signal that helps KNN identify a high-risk neighborhood without using labels",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where((plas > 120.895) & (mass > 31.993), 1, 0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "overall_metabolic_risk_judgment",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Holistic semantic assessment of overall metabolic risk profile based on the combination of glucose level, BMI, age, insulin, and pedigree function. Score from 0 (very low risk profile) to 10 (very high risk profile) reflecting how extreme the combination of metabolic indicators is relative to a typical healthy adult.",
      "value_range": [0, 10],
      "feature_family": "cluster_indicator",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a semantically grounded risk axis that can guide KNN toward clinically meaningful neighborhoods when individual features are ambiguous",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    }
  ]
}
